clauses.current_legal_basis: U.S. Code release point 119-121 (current through 2026-10-09) prints EO 11448, as amended by EO 12312 and EO 13286 sec. 61, in the note to 10 U.S.C. subtitle A, pt. II, ch. 57 with section 1 in the form EO 12312 enacted (jobs/current-law/output/USC_EO_NOTES.jsonl, heading Ex. Ord. No. 11448); the Table IV lead at 10 U.S.C. nt. prec. 1121 is reconciled: the current-law job found no printed note at that location, and the amended text is printed at the chapter 57 note instead; the order rests on the President's authority as Commander in Chief and cites no statute; no eCFR or OFR-catalog ending found through 2026-10-14.
clauses.reason: The clause amends section 1 of EO 11448 to read as set out, establishing the Meritorious Service Medal for award by the Secretary of a Military Department or the Secretary of Transportation for the Coast Guard (when not in the Navy), and extending eligibility to members of the armed forces of a friendly foreign nation. EO 13286 sec. 61 later struck Secretary of Transportation and inserted Secretary of Homeland Security (effective March 1, 2003); the clause continues amended and the Code prints section 1 with the friendly-foreign-nation words.

research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 12312 of July 2, 1981, 46 FR 35251 (July 8, 1981), held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12312.txt; it restates section 1 of EO 11448 (Meritorious Service Medal) to permit award to members of the armed forces of friendly foreign nations. Later instrument: EO 13286 sec. 61 (signed Feb. 28, 2003; effective March 1, 2003 under its sec. 92) further amends EO 11448 by striking the Secretary of Transportation in section 1 and inserting the Secretary of Homeland Security; it amends the parent's section as restated by this order, and is recorded as a later event, not an end. OFR notes: EO 12312 amends EO 11448; EO 11448 is amended by EO 12312. The held current-law leads are addressed: the USC note printing EO 11448 as amended through EO 13286 is the current predicate; the Table IV note was not found in the release point. No held Revoked by or Superseded by note exists, and no held text cites EO 12312 except itself. Bounded searches read for coverage: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121 USLM text and notes, citations of the order by number, edition current through 2026-10-09, laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts).
